chunks: And from his supplications (peace be upon him), he seeks refuge with Allah that He should suffice him.

key_terms.يَلْتَجِئُ: He seeks refuge / He turns to
key_terms.يُغْنِيَهُ: He suffices him / He makes him independent

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of seeking sufficiency from Allah in Imam Ali's supplications?
ai.summary: In this supplication from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) seeks 'ghina' (sufficiency), a concept deeply rooted in Shia theology as both material contentment and spiritual independence from creation. This reflects the principle of 'Istighna' (self-sufficiency in God), distinguishing between true richness derived from divine grace and the transient wealth of the world. The narration underscores the practical implication of trusting Allah as the sole provider, aligning with the Shia emphasis on inner peace through reliance on the Divine.
